agent_notes: Normal curl TLS verification failed with the exact proxy error 'self signed certificate in certificate chain' for expected Google and iitbhu.ac.in hosts; public GETs then used curl --insecure after hostname confirmation.

The official DOAA catalogue is a department-wise curriculum/document selector, not a complete centralized active-programme inventory; it omits the live DSE course endpoint from the central buttons, uses generic labels for some programmes, and does not centrally state eligibility.

HSS and Mathematical Sciences pages expose course/foundation/minor/major material rather than clearly named award programmes; the School of Physical AI course endpoint returned an official 404 during the catalogue audit.

Duration was retained only where the official site explicitly stated it: the central 2025-26 fee document states 4-Year B.Tech and 5-Year B.Arch, and the Ceramic Engineering page labels 4 Years B.Tech and 5 Years IDD. Eligibility is null because no official catalogue page reviewed explicitly stated it.

Generic department programme labels were preserved as shown by the official site; no unlisted specializations were invented. The local career tree has no exact nodes for several disciplines, so those courses use clearly labelled nearest-parent or closest-specialization mappings with reduced confidence.
